shortDescription: CyberArk User Management using Privilege Cloud Share Services REST APIs.

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: A string containing the base URL of the server hosting CyberArk's Privileged Cloud ISP SDK.

options.name: authentication_method
options.description: The user authentication method.

options.name: business_address
options.description: The user's postal address, including city, state, zip, country and street

options.name: change_pass_on_next_logon
options.description: Whether or not the user must change their password in their next logon.

options.name: cyberark_session
options.description: Dictionary set by a CyberArk authentication containing the different values to perform actions on a logged-on CyberArk session, please see M(cyberark.isp.cyberark_authentication) module for an example of cyberark_session.

options.name: description
options.description: Notes and comments.

options.name: distinguished_name
options.description: The user's distinguished name. The usage is for PKI authentication, this will match the certificate Subject Name or domain name.

options.name: domain_name
options.description: The name of the user domain.

options.name: enable_user
options.description: Whether or not the user will be disabled.

options.name: expiry_date
options.description: The date and time when the user account will expire and become disabled.

options.name: group_name
options.description: The name of the group the user will be added to. Causes an additional lookup in cyberark Will be ignored if vault_id is used Will cause a failure if group is missing or more than one group with that name exists

options.name: initial_password
options.description: The password that the new user will use to log on the first time. This password must meet the password policy requirements. This parameter is required when state is present -- Add User.

options.name: internet
options.description: The user's email addresses, including home page and email, business and other email

options.name: location
options.description: The Vault Location for the user.

options.name: logging_file
options.description: Setting the log file name and location for troubleshooting logs.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output to the C(logging_file) value.

options.name: member_type
options.description: The type of member.

options.name: non_authorized_interfaces
options.description: The CyberArk interfaces that this user is not authorized to use.

options.name: password
options.description: The password that the user will use to log on for the first time. This password must meet the password policy requirements. Not required for PKI or LDAP.

options.name: password_never_expires
options.description: Password never expires.

options.name: personal_details
options.description: The user's personal details including firstName, middleName, lastName, address city, state, zip, country title, organization, department, profession

options.name: phones
options.description: The user's phone numbers, including home, business, cellular, fax and pager

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the state needed for the user present for create user, absent for delete user.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the server to send data before giving up

options.name: user_type
options.description: The type of user. The parameter defaults to C(EPVUser).

options.name: username
options.description: The name of the user who will be queried (for details), added, updated or deleted.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificate chain will not be validated.  This should only set to C(true) if you have a root CA certificate installed on each node.

options.name: vault_authorization
options.description: A list of authorization options for this user. Options can include AddSafes and AuditUsers The default provides backwards compatability with older versions of the collection

options.name: vault_id
options.description: The ID of the user group to add the user to Prefered over group_name
